verdict.rationale: dLocal is a payments platform, not an AI agent or assistant, so acting as an MCP client that plugs in external MCP servers to use their tools is outside its product category. The evidence describes dLocal's own MCP server, which serves dLocal's systems to an external agent. That is the server role and does not make this client-side axis apply. The docs' links to ChatGPT and Claude are likewise not MCP client support.
